server.name: io.github.microhenrio/openocd-mcp
server.description: Debug microcontrollers via OpenOCD: flash, breakpoints, memory, registers and variables.
server.title: OpenOCD Debugger

environmentVariables.description: Path to OpenOCD binary; optional.
environmentVariables.name: OPENOCD_BIN

environmentVariables.description: Path to openocd-mcp.json config; optional.
environmentVariables.name: OPENOCD_MCP_CONFIG

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to force read-only mode; optional.
environmentVariables.name: OPENOCD_MCP_READONLY

server.name: io.github.microhenrio/openocd-mcp
server.description: Debug microcontrollers from Claude via OpenOCD: flash, breakpoints, memory and registers by name.
server.title: OpenOCD Debugger

environmentVariables.description: Path to the OpenOCD executable. Optional: if unset, the server uses a bundled copy (when present) or 'openocd' on PATH.
environmentVariables.name: OPENOCD_BIN

environmentVariables.description: Path to a per-project openocd-mcp.json (target_cfg/svd_file/elf_file). Optional: by default the server looks for openocd-mcp.json in the working directory.
environmentVariables.name: OPENOCD_MCP_CONFIG
